desc: Filter nums to only consider elements <= threshold, as elements > threshold cannot form any edge (lcm >= element > threshold).
For each divisor d from 1 to threshold, find all numbers in the filtered nums that are multiples of d and <= threshold.
Union all such numbers found for each divisor d together in the Union-Find structure.
Count the number of unique connected components by counting the number of distinct roots in the Union-Find structure for all original nums elements.
Return the count of connected components.
